letters.subject: Invoice NTS-5521: please confirm your VAT number
letters.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice NTS-5521, dated 22 October 2026, for £228.00. The VAT registration number shown, GB 571 2240 71, does not pass HMRC's check, so we can't reclaim the £38.00 VAT until it is confirmed.

Could you confirm your VAT registration number, please, by Friday 13 November? It may just be a typing error on the invoice.

Kind regards,
Accounts Assistant
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: October payroll query: Jordan Hale (E008)

Could you confirm which figure is correct and send a corrected report if needed? We need a reply by Friday 13 November at the latest, and sooner if possible, as it affects the wages payment.

Demo Company Ltd
